This [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] '''base''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altyr V]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening crawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, we can deduce that ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> it came under [[Battle of Altyr V (Galactic Civil War)|attack]] by two artificial [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]. Thanks to the efforts of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kyle Katarn]], the base [[Unidentified New Republic commander|commander]] managed to evacuate all personnel before the main Imperial force emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Altyr V base was created for the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''.<ref name="MOTS" />
